title: Aryamman Bhatia
html:
Student of semiconductors; conspiring to build indigenous, frontier fab capability.

Currently Exploring - AI-native chip fabs

Founded HackerFab @ IITB, built DIY semiconductor fabrication equipment to make the industry more accessible to students. Fabricated my own devices.

My work in the media — RuntimeBRT, Swarajya Magazine

Engineering

  • Maskless Lithography — clean and repeatable 3 µm features achieved
  • DC Magnetron Sputter — plasma-based nanometer-scale metal deposition
  • Fabricated semiconductor devices — engineered a process on entirely self made equipment

Community

  • Running Junction — a residency to seed semiconductor talent in India
  • Taught a course on semiconductor device physics

Writing

  • The Silicon Chakravyuha — Part 1
